title: Municipal Councils (Amendment)
long_title: AN ACT TO AMEND THE MUNICIPAL COUNCILS ORDINANCE

edition.caveat: private republisher, not the Government Printer

body.heading: Short title.
body.raw_text: 1. This Act may be cited as the Municipal Councils (Amendment) Act, No. 19 of 1987.
body.text: This Act may be cited as the Municipal Councils (Amendment) Act, No. 19 of 1987.

body.heading: Amendment of section 40 of Chapter 252.
body.raw_text: 2. Section 40 of the Municipal Councils Ordinance (hereinafter referred to' as the" principal enactment") is hereby amended in subsection (1) of that section as follows:
body.text: Section 40 of the Municipal Councils Ordinance (hereinafter referred to' as the" principal enactment") is hereby amended in subsection (1) of that section as follows:

children.raw_text: (a) by the insertion, immediately after paragraph (k) of that subsection, of the following paragraph:
children.text: by the insertion, immediately after paragraph (k) of that subsection, of the following paragraph:

children.raw_text: (kk) to exercise, perform and discharge, any power, duty or function delegated to it by the Development Council constituted for the administrative district within the limits of which the municipality is situated; and to implement any work or scheme assigned to it for implementation by such Development Council; ";

body.heading: Amendment of section 188 of the principal enactment.
body.raw_text: 3. Section. 188 of the principal enactment is hereby amended in subsection (1) of that section as follows:
body.text: Section. 188 of the principal enactment is hereby amended in subsection (1) of that section as follows:

children.raw_text: (a) by the repeal of paragraph (j) of that subsection, and the substitution of the following paragraph therefor: - "(j) all expenses incurred. by the Council in the establishment and maintenance of maternity and child welfare service, the provision of health education, the maintenance. of primary health care centres and community development projects, the training of midwives for the purposes of any maternity service established by the Council, and charities or measures for the relief of distress caused by the rain, floods, fire, earthquake, gales; famine or epidemics;";
